chunks: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh and Ibrahim the sons of Nusayr, from Muhammad b. Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham b. al-Hakam who said:

Abu Musa al-Banna entered in to see Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) accompanied by a number of his companions. Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to them: Take care of this old man! He said: Thereafter Abu Musa set off on the road to Makka. He departed from Quzah and was never seen again.

key_terms.أَبُو مُوسَىٰ الْبَنَّاءُ: Abu Musa al-Banna, a companion known as 'the builder'
key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, a title for Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq
key_terms.الْكَشِّيُّ: Al-Kashshi, referring to the biographical work Rijal al-Kashshi
key_terms.قُزَحَ: Quzah, a place in the desert near Mecca

ai.seo_question: What happened to Abu Musa al-Banna after his visit to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kashi’s *Rijal* highlights the high esteem in which Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) held Abu Musa al-Banna, instructing his companions to 'guard' or 'take care of' him, a phrase often interpreted as indicating special spiritual status or protection. After departing from Quzah towards Mecca, Abu Musa disappeared into the desert, marking the end of his known presence in historical records. This account serves as a key piece of evidence in Shia biographical studies regarding the reliability and prominence of the narrator Abu Musa al-Banna.

en.ammaar-muslim: 1. [1/295] Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh and Ibrahim the sons of Nusayr from Muhammad b. Isa from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham b. al-Hakam who said:

Abu Musa al-Banna entered in to see Abi Abdillah عليه السلام accompanied by a number of his companions. Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said to them [i.e. the companions]: Take care of this old man [i.e. Abu Musa]! He [Hisham] said: Thereafter Abu Musa set off on the road to Makka to attend to his affairs. He departed from Quzah and was never seen again [was lost in the desert].
